subject: general
question:
Identify the ANTONYM of the following word in the given sentence.

Furious

The frantic leader was outraged at the failure of his subordinate who unexpectedly was unperturbed.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Unperturbed**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Furious"** means extremely angry or full of rage. (गुस्से में भरा हुआ)

 
 
• **Example: **The manager was furious when he discovered the error in the report.
 
 
 
• **"Unperturbed" **refers to not being disturbed or agitated; remaining calm under pressure or in the face of trouble. (शांत)
 
 
• **Example: **Despite the chaos around her, she remained unperturbed and focused on her work.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Furious' **is **'Unperturbed'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Unperturbed**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained:

 
• **Frantic **(बेचैन): Wildly excited or desperate.

 
 
• **Example:** The frantic mother searched for her lost child in the crowded market.
 
 
 
• **Outraged **(क्रोधित): Feeling or expressing strong anger, shock, or indignation.
 
 
• **Example: **The public was outraged by the scandal.
 
 
 
• **Failure** (असफलता): Lack of success in doing or achieving something.
 
 
• **Example:** The failure of the project was a big setback for the team.
